answer.original_source: NN, Inc., as reported by finance.yahoo.com; the announcement was in late June 2026, with no exact original publication day provided.
answer.new_information: NN announced that it would add 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid-cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks. The source also says the capacity was fully pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards and targets US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026. This is supply-chain context, not a stated change to NVIDIA’s outlook or investment case; the revenue target belongs to NN, and the record gives no shipment, revenue-recognition, or NVIDIA financial-impact confirmation. No stored questions or pieces were provided to update.
